detailed_descriptions.en: Take control of the train which will become your haven on the rails. Collect resources, craft equipment, construct a cozy house on railway cars, and travel through the carefully handcrafted locations to explore the story of a zombie apocalypse world. Features Take control of the train which will become your haven on the rails. Explore the story by traveling through the extensive and carefully handcrafted locations where each of which will require you to overcome some specific challenges. Find a robotic companion. Equip your robot with combat and support equipment to make your adventures easier. Construct a home on railway cars. Various workbenches, storage containers, dozens of decoration elements, and the possibility to place any inventory item on any surface, will allow you to unleash your creativity and build a cozy mobile house that will keep you safe from the dangers of the outer world. Fight against a horde of various zombies. Each type of zombie has its own behavior, tactics, strengths, and weakness. Loot and craft different weapons to improve your survival capabilities.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Take control of the train which will become your haven on the rails. Collect resources, craft equipment, construct a cozy house on railway cars, and travel through the carefully handcrafted locations to explore the story of a zombie apocalypse world.

Features


Take control of the train which will become your haven on the rails.



Explore the story by traveling through the extensive and carefully handcrafted locations where each of which will require you to overcome some specific challenges.



Find a robotic companion. Equip your robot with combat and support equipment to make your adventures easier.



Construct a home on railway cars. Various workbenches, storage containers, dozens of decoration elements, and the possibility to place any inventory item on any surface, will allow you to unleash your creativity and build a cozy mobile house that will keep you safe from the dangers of the outer world.





Fight against a horde of various zombies. Each type of zombie has its own behavior, tactics, strengths, and weakness. Loot and craft different weapons to improve your survival capabilities.
